title: Claims Turnaround Time (TAT) Analytics
text:
AC2 · TAT Trend Over Time
The charts below show average TAT for claims that completed (received a paid date) within each period. Use the toggle to switch between weekly and monthly granularity.


Show code
# Weekly
weekly_tat <- paid_claims |>
  mutate(period = floor_date(paid_date, "week", week_start = 1)) |>
  group_by(period) |>
  summarise(
    avg_tat = mean(tat_days),
    med_tat = median(tat_days),
    n       = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(n >= 5) |>
  mutate(granularity = "Weekly")

# Monthly
monthly_tat <- paid_claims |>
  mutate(period = floor_date(paid_date, "month")) |>
  group_by(period) |>
  summarise(
    avg_tat = mean(tat_days),
    med_tat = median(tat_days),
    n       = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(granularity = "Monthly")



📅 Weekly📆 Monthly




Show code
p_week <- ggplot(weekly_tat, aes(x = period)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = avg_tat - 4, ymax = avg_tat + 4),
              fill = pal$primary, alpha = 0.10) +
  geom_line(aes(y = avg_tat, colour = "Mean TAT"),  linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = med_tat, colour = "Median TAT"), linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(aes(y = avg_tat, colour = "Mean TAT",
                 text = glue("Week: {format(period,'%d %b %Y')}\nMean TAT: {round(avg_tat,1)} days\nClaims: {n}")),
             size = 2, shape = 21, fill = "white", stroke = 1.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 30, linetype = "dotted", colour = pal$red,
             linewidth = 0.7) +
  annotate("text", x = min(weekly_tat$period) + 3, y = 31.8,
           label = "30-day target", hjust = 0, size = 2.8, colour = pal$red) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Mean TAT" = pal$primary, "Median TAT" = pal$accent),
                      name = NULL) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%d %b", date_breaks = "4 weeks") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .12)),
                     labels = \(x) paste0(x, "d")) +
  labs(title    = "Average TAT by Week",
       subtitle = "Jan – Dec 2024 · Plotted on paid date · Shaded band = ±4 days",
       x = NULL, y = "Avg TAT (days)")

ggplotly(p_week, tooltip = "text") |>
  layout(legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = -0.15))










Show code
p_month <- ggplot(monthly_tat, aes(x = period)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = avg_tat,
               text = glue("{format(period,'%b %Y')}\nMean: {round(avg_tat,1)}d\nMedian: {round(med_tat,1)}d\nClaims: {n}")),
           fill = pal$primary, alpha = 0.75, width = 22) +
  geom_line(aes(y = avg_tat),  colour = pal$primary, linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = med_tat),  colour = pal$accent,  linewidth = 0.9, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(aes(y = avg_tat), colour = pal$primary, size = 3) +
  geom_point(aes(y = med_tat), colour = pal$accent,  size = 2.5, shape = 21,
             fill = "white", stroke = 1.2) +
  geom_text(aes(y = avg_tat, label = round(avg_tat, 1)),
            vjust = -0.9, size = 2.7, colour = pal$text) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 30, linetype = "dotted", colour = pal$red, linewidth = 0.7) +
  annotate("text", x = min(monthly_tat$period) + 5, y = 31.8,
           label = "30-day target", hjust = 0, size = 2.8, colour = pal$red) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b '%y", date_breaks = "1 month") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .15)),
                     labels = \(x) paste0(x, "d")) +
  labs(title    = "Average TAT by Month",
       subtitle = "Jan – Dec 2024 · Bars = mean · Dashed line = median · Label = mean days",
       x = NULL, y = "Avg TAT (days)")

ggplotly(p_month, tooltip = "text") |>
  layout(showlegend = FALSE)

title: Claims Turnaround Time (TAT) Analytics
text:
TAT Distribution


Show code
p_dist <- paid_claims |>
  mutate(month_lbl = format(paid_month, "%b")) |>
  filter(paid_month >= as.Date("2024-07-01")) |>   # last 6 months for readability
  ggplot(aes(x = tat_days, y = after_stat(density))) +
  geom_histogram(fill = pal$primary, alpha = 0.7, binwidth = 5, boundary = 0) +
  geom_density(colour = pal$accent, linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 30, colour = pal$red, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", x = 31, y = Inf, label = "30d", hjust = 0, vjust = 1.5,
           size = 3, colour = pal$red) +
  facet_wrap(~month_lbl, nrow = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = c(0, 30, 60, 90)) +
  labs(title    = "TAT Distribution by Month (Jul – Dec 2024)",
       subtitle = "Histogram + density curve · Dashed = 30-day target",
       x = "TAT (days)", y = "Density")

p_dist

title: Claims Turnaround Time (TAT) Analytics
text:
Monthly Summary Table


Show code
table_data <- paid_claims |>
  mutate(month = floor_date(paid_date, "month")) |>
  group_by(Month = month) |>
  summarise(
    `Claims Paid`  = n(),
    `Min TAT`      = min(tat_days),
    `P25 TAT`      = quantile(tat_days, 0.25),
    `Median TAT`   = round(median(tat_days), 1),
    `Mean TAT`     = round(mean(tat_days), 1),
    `P75 TAT`      = quantile(tat_days, 0.75),
    `Max TAT`      = max(tat_days),
    `% ≤ 30 days`  = round(mean(tat_days <= 30) * 100, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(Month = format(Month, "%b %Y"))

table_data |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(
    title    = md("**Monthly TAT Summary — 2024**"),
    subtitle = "TAT = Paid Date − Created Date"
  ) |>
  tab_spanner(
    label   = "Turnaround Time (days)",
    columns = c(`Min TAT`, `P25 TAT`, `Median TAT`, `Mean TAT`, `P75 TAT`, `Max TAT`)
  ) |>
  fmt_number(columns = `Claims Paid`,  decimals = 0, use_seps = TRUE) |>
  fmt_number(columns = c(`Min TAT`, `P25 TAT`, `Median TAT`,
                         `Mean TAT`, `P75 TAT`, `Max TAT`),
             decimals = 1) |>
  fmt_number(columns = `% ≤ 30 days`, decimals = 1, pattern = "{x}%") |>
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = -Month) |>
  cols_align(align = "left",   columns = Month) |>
  data_color(
    columns = `Median TAT`,
    method  = "numeric",
    palette = c("#0E9F6E", "#FFFBEB", "#E02424"),
    domain  = c(15, 40)
  ) |>
  data_color(
    columns = `% ≤ 30 days`,
    method  = "numeric",
    palette = c("#E02424", "#FFFBEB", "#0E9F6E"),
    domain  = c(50, 90)
  ) |>
  gtExtras::gt_highlight_rows(
    rows      = Month == "Nov 2024",
    fill      = "#EFF6FF",
    font_weight = "bold"
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style     = list(cell_fill(color = "#1A56DB"),
                     cell_text(color = "white", weight = "bold")),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style     = list(cell_fill(color = "#1A56DB"),
                     cell_text(color = "white", weight = "bold")),
    locations = cells_column_spanners()
  ) |>
  tab_options(
    table.font.size               = 13,
    heading.title.font.size       = 15,
    table.width                   = pct(100),
    table.border.top.color        = "transparent",
    table.border.bottom.color     = "transparent",
    row.striping.background_color = "#F8F9FC",
    row.striping.include_table_body = TRUE
  ) |>
  opt_row_striping() |>
  tab_footnote(
    footnote  = "Highlighted row = current reporting month (Nov 2024)",
    locations = cells_title(groups = "subtitle")
  )

Field

Unique claim identifier


created_date
Date the claim was submitted (TAT start)


paid_date
Date the claim was paid (TAT end)


tat_days
paid_date − created_date in calendar days


is_paid
Boolean — whether a paid date exists




Note: Sample data is randomly generated with set.seed(42). Replace the data generation block with your actual claims extract.

2 2. Calculation Logic & Formula
This section defines the “North Star” for the Backend Team.

2.1 Mathematical Definition
The indicator is calculated as: \[Indicator = \frac{\sum(\text{Successful Transactions})}{\sum(\text{Total Attempts})} \times 100\]


2.2 Logic Rules

Inclusion: Include only records where status = 'ACTIVE'.
Exclusion: Ignore test accounts (IDs starting with TEST_).
Null Handling: If denominator is 0, return null (not 0).
